name: personal-finance-manager
description: Cross-platform desktop application for tracking, analyzing, and managing personal finances

scripts.start:electron: npm run build:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.start:db-only: npm run build:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.db:setup: npm run rebuild-sqlite && npm run db:init
scripts.clean:dist: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-ChildItem .\dist -File | Where-Object { ($_.Name -like 'bundle*') -or ($_.Name -in @('index.html','builder-debug.yml','builder-effective-config.yaml')) } | Remove-Item -Force; if (Test-Path .\dist\assets) { Remove-Item .\dist\assets -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path .\dist\.icon-ico) { Remove-Item .\dist\.icon-ico -Recurse -Force }"
scripts.prepare:msix: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$pkg = Get-Content .\package.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $versionParts = $pkg.version.Split('.'); $msixVersion = if ($versionParts.Length -eq 3) { \"$($pkg.version).0\" } elseif ($versionParts.Length -eq 4) { $pkg.version } else { throw 'package.json version must have 3 or 4 numeric parts for MSIX packaging.' }; $staging = '.\dist\msix-staging'; if (Test-Path $staging) { Remove-Item $staging -Recurse -Force }; Copy-Item .\dist\win-unpacked $staging -Recurse; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $staging 'Assets') | Out-Null; Copy-Item .\src\assets\images\logo.png (Join-Path $staging 'Assets\Square44x44Logo.png') -Force; Copy-Item .\src\assets\images\logo.png (Join-Path $staging 'Assets\Square150x150Logo.png') -Force; Copy-Item .\src\assets\images\logo.png (Join-Path $staging 'Assets\StoreLogo.png') -Force; Copy-Item .\src\assets\images\logo.png (Join-Path $staging 'Assets\SplashScreen.png') -Force; $manifest = Get-Content .\msix\Package.appxmanifest.template -Raw; $manifest = $manifest.Replace('__VERSION__', $msixVersion).Replace('__IDENTITY_NAME__', 'KlediJenicerri.LibriDesktop').Replace('__PUBLISHER__', 'CN=0CB9D586-4887-436E-B669-9FA04EBC5D48').Replace('__PUBLISHER_DISPLAY_NAME__', 'Kledi Jenicerri').Replace('__DISPLAY_NAME__', 'Libri Desktop').Replace('__DESCRIPTION__', 'Private, local desktop finance tracker.').Replace('__EXECUTABLE__', 'Libri.exe'); Set-Content (Join-Path $staging 'Package.appxmanifest') $manifest -Encoding UTF8"
scripts.build: npm run build:webpack && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production webpack --config webpack.prod.js && npm run build:electron
scripts.package:msix: electron-builder --win --dir && npm run prepare:msix && npx @microsoft/winappcli@latest pack .\dist\msix-staging --output .\dist\LibriDesktop.msix
scripts.dist: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:prod && npm run package
scripts.dist:msix: npm run build:prod && npm run package:msix
